scripts.fmt: bunx prettier --write src tests package.json docs/package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.fmt:check: bunx prettier --check src tests package.json docs/package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:parity: bun run compile && BENTO_BIN=$PWD/dist/bento REQUIRE_BENTO_BIN=1 bun test tests/contract/parity_test.ts --timeout 120000
scripts.smoke:compiled: bun run compile && dist/bento version && dist/bento --stack ${BENTO_SMOKE_STACK:-/tmp/bento-smoke-$$} init && dist/bento --stack ${BENTO_SMOKE_STACK:-/tmp/bento-smoke-$$} render && dist/bento --stack ${BENTO_SMOKE_STACK:-/tmp/bento-smoke-$$} status
scripts.ci: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run check && bun run test && bun run test:integration
